book.title: Matta Laɓara na Mbǝnggǝn aten Yeeso

content: Mǝrra Yahaya Tǝbaptisǝma
A sayidɗi Sǝkna Hirdus Kutǝr chehweed Nggalili laɓar Yeeso,
ndanggǝn fataryighǝn, “Yahaya Tǝbaptisǝma ni ya thliigha sǝ hu mǝrra! Ndǝn nanǝn tǝ sǝsǝmnda ǝna ǝnwultenggini ya.”
Nanǝnya Hirdus ˈwaɗǝ teena ƙǝsang ɗǝ Yahaya, ƙǝnanggǝn, muwanggǝn hu porsǝna ɗǝ ka Herodiya nu wanman Filibus kahang nǝn.
Ƙǝsǝr Yahaya nǝn naarha ndang nda Hirdus ahu ngyakhrha Yahudaya kamngwa a kahanggǝn Herodiya wa.
Na mid Hirdus sǝ a ɓǝlanggǝn Yahaya, amma nǝghǝn a tǝrǝm fiya, ƙǝsǝr fiya heu fǝr nda kǝkafek tǝ ndaarha Yahaya Annabi ni.
Amma a far wutsǝfayid lǝghǝtta ɓen nggǝtta Hirdus, wutarad Herodiya rǝɓanggǝn kanda sǝ, mbǝnanggǝn Hirdus kaan.
Nggǝmɗa fa har tǝ aah thlǝm Faara, kala ˈya na midghǝn nǝn a fǝranggǝn.
Ndangga man wutaradɗi ɗǝgha ndaarha, “Ten Yahaya Tǝbaptisǝma na minna ahu pǝlee.”
Kutǝrɗi ƙǝm ǝna masǝnɗi kee nǝn aten ˈya ndanǝn, amma ƙǝsǝr ka thlǝm Faara aah nǝn a mbed nafiya mbunǝn ɓa, ǝnang ǝnɗa nda ndanǝn.
Thlǝn sodjaya nǝn a kyathlang ngganda ten Yahaya ɓa ahu porsǝna.
Ɓang ten ɗa nda wutaradɗa ɓa ahu pǝlee, ɗanggǝnǝn man ɗǝ.
Tsǝɓaku ɓagha fatsahaya Yahaya ɓa tǝrang ngganda mǝrrǝghǝn ɓa pang ngganda, tǝrgha ɗǝnda ɗǝ pǝranggǝn nda Yeeso.
Hǝɓang Yeeso nafiya haru kumnggit tuf
Sǝkna Yeeso laɓarɗi, kyagha hu kombuwol hai, mal mbǝɗa nǝn ɗǝgha mbǝrha ɗǝ ka a tsauka katenggǝn. Amma sǝkna fiya mbǝɗi nanǝn sǝ, mbu samadghǝn nda tǝ saara ahu talya ɓa hangga.
Tǝrna Yeeso hai ahu kombuwol ɗi, na fiya nǝn hangga haɗangganda fa, ƙǝnanggǝn haya.
Na figrha a tsǝrha hai, ɓagha fa tsahayighǝn a thlǝmadghǝn ɓa, ndang ngganda, “Kaheerha ni ya tǝ kǝm tsǝ figrha hai, kalu fiya hai ɗǝnda hu talya ɗǝ, tǝna nda ɗǝ hii ǝnnarhami.”
Amma nggǝrangga Yeeso kanda sǝ, “Kamngwa a wii nda a miirha wa, fǝraman ˈya kanda ǝna nda mii.”
Ndangga nda, “Mburodi tuf ni kee a harnan, tǝ tǝngya sǝri.”
Ndagha, “Ɓemadghǝn mbǝɗa ɓa ya.”

Tǝrgha ndanggǝn fiya tsawanda hai a ten hwaliirha, tǝranggǝn mburodi ɗa sǝ tuf tǝ tǝnggini sǝri, kǝlagha talara sǝ, ɗǝfang parka nǝn in. Kyanggǝn mburodi ɗa hai fǝranggǝnǝn fatsahayighǝn ndǝghang nggǝnda fiya.
Kii nda kanda heu kǝla na mindan pa tsǝghanggǝn kanda, tǝrgha fatsahayighǝn wumangga nda katǝbghǝn kutasya kumkap sǝri.
Hǝshya kiigha mburodi ɗi sǝl nda haru kumnggit tuf, thlǝɗang ngwa nda nishya tǝ wundakhnaya wa.
Wii Yeeso a ten aama
Tsu a mbǝɗi kee, ndangga Yeeso fatsahayighǝn kya nda hu kombuwal hai tǝɗang ngganda wuri aama teena, ndǝghǝnggi ƙǝm ishgha hai kal fiya nǝn hai.
A kwasamad ɗi kal nǝn fiya hai, tǝrgha wumnda sǝ katenggǝn ka a hwan Faara nǝn, tsǝgha figrha hai ndǝghǝn a mbǝɗi katenggǝn.
Amma ahu sayidɗiya kombuwol ɗi inggun ma ƙǝkǝshɓanda, fatsahayini a habɓaarha tǝ ɓereurha tǝ kuɗufulla aama.
Takhna mbǝrha a ɗathla hai ɓagha Yeeso thlǝman ndan ɓa, a wiirha aten aama.
Nana fatsahayighǝn ndǝn a wiirha aten aamɗi tǝrma nda. Ka hǝreenga huhwa nda, tamngganda ndaarha mǝnda-mǝnda ni.
Amma tsu kee kalangga Yeeso kanda sǝ, “A tǝrǝm ɗun wa nggini ƙǝrsaama.”
Ndangga Siman, “Chinǝm, ana ƙǝkafek sani, ndee ɗi thlǝmad wa ɗǝ a aten aamɗi.”
Ndangga Yeeso, “Haˈi, ɓoɓa,” tǝrgha siman tǝrgha hai ahu kombuwal ɗi, ƙǝs wiirha nǝn aten aamɗi a thlǝmad Yeeso ɗǝ.
Amma nanǝn ɓereu ˈyaarɗi tǝrǝmngga, nagha a timnda hai, huhwagha ndagha, “Hǝrye Chinǝm.”
Tsu kee Ƙǝsgha Yeeso harghǝn ƙǝsanggǝn ɓa, ndangga Yeeso, “Ƙǝɗi fǝrƙǝkafekkid wa, ƙǝn fǝr waana ƙǝkafek na mbang wiirha aten aamɗi?”
Kyana nda ahu kombuwal hai, ishgha ɓereu ˈyaarɗi.
Tǝrgha fatsahayighǝn ɗǝfang shilee nda in, na nda a ndaarha, “Ƙǝkafek Wan Faarani Sa.”
Ƙǝnang Yeeso haaya a Djanasarat
A kwasamadɗi tǝɗang na nda wuri aamɗi teena, tǝra nda hai a Djanasarat.
Kukwalang na nafiya talɗa hai Yeeso ni, thlǝn farha nda ahu talya ɗǝ na ahu chehwedɗi kahat. Nagha fiya a ɓarha ɓa tǝ haaya, ka a ƙǝnanggǝn kanda.
Hwanggǝnda a malanggǝn haaya tsuwar mii kotodghǝnda fa kee, kala niifa tsuwargha ndǝn fa ƙǝnɗǝ.
